# Generated by tools/codegen/gen_controller.py from controllers/esp32-t12-controller/controller.toml. Do not edit; change the description and regenerate.
# t12_controller_tests: the controller library and its Unity tests on the PC, without
# PlatformIO (pio test -e native runs the same tests), and its PC tools (tools/*.c):
#   cmake -S test -B <build> && cmake --build <build> && ctest --test-dir <build>
#   cmake --build <build> --target t12_scenarios && <build>/t12_scenarios ...
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(t12_controller_tests C)
include(../../../cmake/krumpir.cmake)

krumpir_add_libs()
krumpir_add_subdirectory_once(t12ctrl ../lib/t12ctrl t12ctrl)

enable_testing()
krumpir_unity_tests("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" PREFIX t12_ t12ctrl)

# The controller's PC tools, one program per tools/*.c (t12_scenarios, ...), against its
# library and the on-chip plant. test/ and host/ both add them; in one tree the first one does.
file(GLOB ctrl_tools CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../tools/*.c")
foreach(src ${ctrl_tools})
  get_filename_component(stem ${src} NAME_WE)
  if(NOT TARGET t12_${stem})
    add_executable(t12_${stem} ${src})
    target_link_libraries(t12_${stem} PRIVATE t12ctrl krumpir::warnings)
  endif()
endforeach()
